name: HubSpot Orphan Deal Pipeline Sanitization Guard (dhRobin Systems)

parameters.content:
## n8n-hubspot-orphan-deal-pipeline-sanitization-guard
**dhRobin Systems** · Open deals → association, property and staleness audit → quarantine flag/stage, remediation tasks, Slack digest.

**Safe by default.** With no environment variables set:
- `SANDBOX_MODE=true`: synthetic snapshot. **Zero external calls.**
- `DRY_RUN=true`: payloads are built, nothing is sent.
- `SYNC_TO_HUBSPOT=false`: CRM writes need an explicit opt-in.
- `QUARANTINE_MODE=property`: stage moves need a second opt-in.

**Circuit breaker:** a run that would quarantine too many deals, or whose association reads failed, writes nothing and alerts instead.

### Pinned synthetic payloads
Pinned: Daily Hygiene Audit, HubSpot: Get Deal Pipelines, Search Open Deals, both association reads, Batch Update Deals, Batch Create Remediation Tasks, Slack.

Pins apply to **manual executions only**; scheduled production runs ignore them. Unpin a node before a manual live test of that integration.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Typed, non-secret runtime configuration under config.*.

nodes.name: Mock Audit Snapshot
nodes.notes: Nine fictitious deals, one per rule path.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Deal Pipelines
nodes.notes: Pipeline and stage metadata (open vs. closed, quarantine stage validation).

nodes.name: Build Deal Search Request
nodes.notes: Target pipelines, open stages and invalid-stage filter groups.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Open Deals
nodes.notes: Cursor pagination, 100 per page, 300 ms apart, ≤100 pages (HubSpot's 10,000-result ceiling).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Read Deal→Company Associations
nodes.notes: v4 batch read. Fails the run on error, so a partial read can never mark deals as orphans.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Read Deal→Contact Associations
nodes.notes: Same batches, read by item index.

nodes.name: Evaluate Sanitization & Orphans
nodes.notes: Rules, severity, action, quarantine stage resolution, circuit breaker.

nodes.name: Compose Quarantine & Digest Payloads
nodes.notes: Changed-only deal updates, remediation tasks, Slack digest.

nodes.name: Dry Run: Audit Preview
nodes.notes: Review stats, circuitBreaker, results, updateBatches, taskBatches and slackPayload. Nothing is sent while DRY_RUN is not 'false'.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Update Deals
nodes.notes: Writes deal_hygiene_* properties and, in stage mode, dealstage. Scope: crm.objects.deals.write.

return $('Compose Quarantine & Digest Payloads').first().json.taskBatches.map((inputs, batchIndex) => ({ json: { batchIndex, inputs } }));

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Create Remediation Tasks
nodes.notes: One task per newly quarantined deal, associated to the deal (associationTypeId 216).

nodes.name: Slack: Post Sanitization Digest
nodes.notes: Internal RevOps channel. The webhook URL is a secret.
